# Easy Paint Pro

> Easy Paint Pro is a simple paint app for Mac in the spirit of classic Paint: a name under every tool, 50+ brushes, gradient, pattern and emoji fills, editable text, shapes and stamps, layers and masks, tab groups, screenshot privacy tools and canvas recording. It needs a Mac with Apple silicon and macOS 14 or later. Every tool is free to try for 7 days, then it's a one-time purchase from this website or an in-app purchase on the Mac App Store. No account, no ads, and pictures stay on the Mac.

## Product

- [Home](https://easypaintpro.com/): what Easy Paint Pro is, with screenshots of the Modern and Classic looks
- [Features](https://easypaintpro.com/features/): every feature in the current version and where to find it in the app
- [Download](https://easypaintpro.com/download/): free 7-day trial, price, system requirements and the Mac App Store link
- [Compare](https://easypaintpro.com/compare/): how it compares with the Mac's Preview, Paint on Windows and professional art apps
- [Gallery](https://easypaintpro.com/gallery.html): pictures made with the app's own tools, including a recording of a pixel-art knight
- [Schools](https://easypaintpro.com/schools/): use in classrooms, lesson ideas and school licenses
- [Work](https://easypaintpro.com/work/): marking up screenshots, hiding private details and quick graphics at work

## Guides

- [Is there MS Paint for Mac?](https://easypaintpro.com/guides/ms-paint-for-mac/): what to use on a Mac instead of Microsoft Paint, and how to do the usual Paint jobs
- [Blur or pixelate part of a screenshot](https://easypaintpro.com/guides/blur-or-pixelate-a-screenshot-on-mac/): hide names, emails and numbers permanently before sharing
- [Remove the background from a picture](https://easypaintpro.com/guides/remove-background-from-a-picture-on-mac/): cut out a subject or clear a plain background and save a transparent PNG
- [Make pixel art on a Mac](https://easypaintpro.com/guides/pixel-art-on-mac/): grid, snapping and square blocks, then export small or large
- [Draw and write on a picture](https://easypaintpro.com/guides/draw-on-a-picture-on-mac/): arrows, highlights, text and stamps on a photo or screenshot
